name: Bazardor
description: A Bangla market price tracker that helps people check and compare daily prices of everyday goods.
challenges: Designing the MongoDB schema to handle prices that change often and vary by market.
Setting up secure user authentication and protecting private routes.
Supporting Bangla text and keeping the interface simple for everyday users.
futureImprovements: Show price history charts and trends over time.
Add price alerts when an item goes above or below a chosen amount.
Let users submit prices and verify them to keep data accurate.

name: Nature's Platter
description: A grocery e-commerce landing page that presents fresh products in a clean, easy-to-browse layout.
challenges: Building a consistent responsive layout for product sections across phones, tablets and desktops.
Optimizing product images so the page loads quickly without losing quality.
Making the design feel fresh and trustworthy for a grocery brand.
futureImprovements: Add a working shopping cart and checkout flow.
Connect the site to a backend with a product database (Node.js and MongoDB).
Add product search, filters and customer reviews.

name: DevStack
description: An interactive tech stack builder where users can explore and pick the tools they need for their next project.
challenges: Managing the state of selected technologies across multiple components so the stack updates instantly.
Designing a clean, responsive layout that stays easy to use on small screens.
Organizing many tools into clear categories without overwhelming the user.
futureImprovements: Let users save and share their custom stacks with a link.
Add user accounts with login so stacks can be stored.
Add more technology categories and short comparisons between tools.
